data.long_meaning: Derived from Old English ‘bannerman’, meaning ‘bearer of a banner’. Historically used for knights and soldiers who carried their leader's flag into battle. The name Bannerman carries the meaning “Bearer of a banner” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Bannerman usually hope their child will grow to embody bearer of a banner and live with faith, good character and purpose.

In contemporary usage, the name can also symbolize a committed and devoted follower or representative of an organization, enterprise, or cause.
data.spiritual_significance: In a Christian context, the name Bannerman can represent a believer in Christ, carrying the standard or symbol of their faith into the world. The name serves as a reminder to remain steadfast in faith and carry Christ with us throughout our lives.
